function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

Here’s a quick rundown of the most popular and highly‑rated men’s underwear styles, along with what makes each one stand out. Whether you’re looking for everyday comfort, performance for workouts, or a touch of luxury, there’s a style (or two) that fits the bill. | Style | Key Features | Ideal For | |-------|--------------|-----------| | **Boxer Briefs** | • Long‑leg cut that covers hips and thighs
• Tighter fit than boxers, but more room than briefs

• Hypoallergenic | Sensitive skin, eco‑conscious shoppers, or those who want a silky feel | | **Luxury/Designer** | • Premium fabrics (silk, cashmere blends, high‑grade cotton)
• Often feature subtle branding or unique stitching | Special occasions, gifts, or when you want to indulge | | **Hybrid (Boxer‑Brief Hybrid)** | • Combines the length of boxers with the support of briefs
• Usually has a supportive pouch and a longer leg | Those who want the best of both worlds – support + coverage | | **Underwire (for men)** | • Rare, but some brands offer a light underwire for added support
• Usually in a brief or trunk cut | Men who need extra support for certain activities or body types | ### How to Pick the Right Style 1. **Consider Your Activity Level** - **Low‑intensity** (work, home): Boxers or briefs. - **High‑intensity** (sports, gym): Performance briefs or trunks. 2. **Think About Comfort vs. Support** - If you’re prone to chafing or need extra support, go for briefs/trunks with a pouch. - If you prefer a relaxed feel, boxers are your best bet. 3. **Fabric Matters** - **Cotton**: Classic, breathable, but can retain moisture. - **Moisture‑wicking blends**: Great for sweat‑heavy activities. - **Bamboo/Modal**: Soft, eco‑friendly, and naturally breathable. - **Silk or cashmere**: Luxury feel, but may not be ideal for intense workouts. 4. **Fit & Size** - Make sure the waistband isn’t too tight or too loose. - Check the pouch size if you need extra support. 5. **Style & Aesthetics** - If you’re wearing shorts or tight pants, trunks or briefs look cleaner. - Boxers can be a fashion statement if you’re into vintage or relaxed looks. ### Top Picks (Brands & Models) | Brand | Model | Why It’s Great | |-------|-------|----------------| | **Calvin Klein** | Classic Briefs | Iconic fit, smooth waistband, great for everyday wear. | | **Uniqlo** | AIRism Boxer Briefs | Ultra‑light, breathable, and affordable. | | **Under Armour** | Tech 6” Performance Briefs | Moisture‑wicking, anti‑odor, perfect for workouts. | | **Tommy John** | Second Skin Boxer Briefs | Seamless design, no chafing, supportive pouch. | | **Saxx** | Underwear with Ball‑Pocket | Innovative pouch design, great for active lifestyles. | | **Lululemon** | Align Boxer Briefs | Ultra‑soft, breathable, and supportive. | | **Bamboo Body** | Bamboo Boxer Briefs | Eco‑friendly, silky feel, and moisture‑absorbing. | | **Jockey** | Comfort Trunks | Classic style, comfortable waistband, good value. | | **Polo Ralph Lauren** | Luxury Cotton Briefs | Premium fabric, subtle branding, great for gifting. | ### Quick Tips - **Rotate**: Having at least 3–4 pairs of each style helps keep them fresh and reduces wear on any single pair. - **Wash Properly**: Use cold water and avoid harsh detergents to preserve elasticity and color. - **Check the Pouch**: For briefs/trunks, a well‑designed pouch can make a huge difference in comfort and support. --- **Bottom line:** - **Boxer briefs** are the all‑rounder for most men. - **Briefs/trunks** are best for support and a sleek look. - **Boxers** are ideal for relaxed, everyday comfort. - **Performance fabrics** are essential if you’re active. Pick the style that matches your lifestyle, and you’ll feel confident and comfortable all day long!
